༄༅༅། ། In the Tibetan language: The Summary of the Empowerment <term>Vajra-mukhya-nirdesha</term> <gloss>Instruction on the Essence of Empowerment</gloss>.

Homage to the glorious <term>Vajrasattva</term> <gloss>Diamond Being</gloss>.

Zla-ba bzang-po <gloss>Moon-Excellent</gloss> requested: "Teacher, regarding the seven types of empowerment and the three types..."

<summary>This text introduces the summary of empowerment rituals within the Vajrayana tradition, beginning with a formal homage to Vajrasattva and a request for instruction from a student named Zla-ba bzang-po.</summary>
<keywords>Vajrasattva, empowerment, initiation, Zla-ba bzang-po, Vajrayana, ritual instruction</keywords>
